name: Open real Mac mini M4 Pro and inspect exterior
description: A recognizably compact Apple Mac mini loads with a rounded silver aluminum lid, Apple mark and front two USB-C plus headphone jack.
steps: Open the gallery on the default Mac mini tab
Verify Mac mini M4 Pro title and 3D device
Orbit the case and identify front USB-C and audio ports
Move the explode slider to 55%
expected: Mac mini M4 Pro is the selected tab. A silver, rounded five-inch compact Mac appears; moving the slider reveals distinct fan, logic board, power supply and other internal layers without any runtime error.

name: Mac mini guided 2024 service sequence
description: The guided sequence follows Apple's actual bottom-entry service hierarchy instead of lifting the upper lid.
steps: Select Mac mini and click Step-by-step
Advance to Flip it over and Unclip the bottom cover
Advance to Disconnect the power button and Remove the antenna plate
Advance through fan, M4 Pro storage and power steps
expected: Camera presents the underside during the guide and reveals each removed component with explanatory text and safety notes; 13 steps are available.

name: Mac mini selectable internal parts
description: Picking an internal group from the sidebar opens the hardware for meaningful examination.
steps: In Explore mode select the Apple M4 Pro SoC row
Observe exploded view percentage
Select the removable flash storage row
Scroll or drag to orbit
expected: The viewer separates enough to expose selected internal parts and the inspector explains Apple Silicon and the proprietary SSD.

name: Preserve four data-center machines and controls
description: Original hardware remains accessible alongside the new mini.
steps: Click GB200 NVL72 and confirm rack-scale model
Click R760, XE9680 and DGX B200 in turn
Click Hide sidebar and then Show sidebar
Activate browser fullscreen and exit
expected: All five hardware tabs and model-specific detail views work; sidebar collapse expands the canvas, and fullscreen works when browser permissions allow.

name: Mac mini mobile usability
description: The mini 3D and bottom teardown should remain accessible at mobile width.
steps: Open the page on a 390px wide phone
Select Mac mini
Use explode slider to 70%
Open Step-by-step and tap Next
Toggle the sidebar
expected: Mac mini remains visible, tab selector is usable without covering controls, guided walkthrough and sidebar toggle are accessible.
